payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple methods for evaluating the quality of data, including BLEU scores, manual inspections, and perplexity measurements.

claims.text: The quality of data is evaluated using sentence-level BLEU scores to compare human translations with automatic translations.
Manual inspections are conducted for translations with low BLEU scores and high perplexity to ensure quality.
The overlap between transcripts and translations is checked to confirm the suitability of the evaluation set.
The stability of model outputs is assessed using average coefficients of variation based on BLEU scores grouped by transcript.
